description: Operator rules override purposes for that operator's agents.
policy:
version: 1
purposes:
  training: block
operators:
  google:
    training: allow
  anthropic:
    user_fetch: block
emit: [robots.txt]
expected:
# robots.txt written by Posterna from agents.yaml.
# Crawlers that honor robots.txt are asked to stay out of what the policy blocks.
# The site's policy engine enforces against agents that do not.

User-agent: *
Allow: /

# Training
User-agent: ClaudeBot
Disallow: /

# User-initiated fetches
User-agent: Claude-User
Disallow: /
